policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: specified advance visitor visas
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA guidance establishes the stated advance-consular visa route.
conditions: CG, ML, NE and GW use named consular application routes; GW explicitly has no direct arrival visa.
KP tourist access remains restricted; SD, sponsorship, invitation, conflict, carrier, health and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: specified electronic pre-travel visa
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA guidance establishes Djibouti's pre-travel eVisa route.
conditions: TD: online entry visa. DJ: eVisa must be requested before travel and no visa is issued at the border.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: specified arrival-issued visitor visas
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA guidance expressly identifies these arrival-issued visitor visa routes.
conditions: BD issue is for stays below 30 days and is not guaranteed; IR requires online e-visa procedure before airport issuance; JO has airport and stated land-border routes.
SY, BF and SL have stated border/airport issuance. Passport, health, invitation, payment, entry-point and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: specified visa-free short stays
policies.summary: Current Italian MFA guidance establishes visa-free short visitor stays.
conditions: UA: EU citizen stays below 90 days. VG: tourism up to one month.
Operational access, work, residence, health, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: Current MFA guidance says Chad's entry visa is obtained online.
MFA guidance says Syrian entry visas are generally issued at airport or land border.
MFA guidance expressly allows Burkina Faso airport issuance at arrival.
MFA guidance expressly says Guinea-Bissau visas cannot be obtained directly on arrival.
MFA guidance requires pre-travel eVisa and says no border visa is issued.

unresolved.reason: Current MFA guidance says a visa is mandatory but notes recent refusals of Italian citizens holding visas and establishes no reliable ordinary visitor issuance timing. No route is inferred.
MFA guidance says a visa is necessary and directs further enquiries to the Central African Embassy in Paris, but does not establish the ordinary visitor issuance timing. No route is inferred.

MFA guidance mentions both Liberian consular application and a named Visa on Arrival site without confirming this Italian ordinary-passport applicant's actual issuance timing or conditions. No route is inferred.
MFA guidance says a visa is necessary but establishes no Italian ordinary-passport issuance timing; carrier check-in practice is not a visa classification.
Palestinian access remains crossing- and permit-dependent. Israel-only authorisation does not establish a single ordinary Italian-passport PS relationship; no complement is inferred.
